Question: Why is my new SIM still showing 'No Service' after 24 hours?

Answer: This can indicate pending KYC verification, a mismatch in submitted documents, or a provisioning delay. Check SIM Services > Activation Status in the app, or contact care with your application/reference number.

Topic: New Connection Activation
title: Why is my new SIM still showing 'No Service' after 24 hours?
